quote: I like asking why. I love knowing why.
coreInfo:
My first word as a baby was “Why”, it sounded more like waah but I was actually trying to ask a question. And I’ve been asking ever since. Asking why is easy, but the fun is understanding why.

I hunt for the human truth hiding in a boring stat and turn it into an insight a campaign can be built on. You can see it in my work below.

I grew up in Canberra, surrounded by politicians, which does leave you with a lot of questions. I escaped and moved to Melbourne because I knew this is where the advertising industry is. I wanted real experience badly enough to take an internship almost two hours away. Now I want an agency strategy career where I never stop understanding new whys.
contactLine: I’m open for all coffee chats, campaign ideas and opportunities.
